title: Network dynamics of momentary affect states and future course of psychopathology in adolescents
limitations: - Sample is limited to a twin cohort, limiting generalizability; - Sample is predominantly Caucasian; - Data collection was at group level, not individual level; - Permutation tests may lack power to detect small but meaningful differences.
notes: The study was not preregistered. Data are not publicly available due to European law and ethical restrictions. Code is available via the supplementary materials (S1 Data).
